# Frontend — assets


## `frontend/assets/app.css`

```css
/* =========================================================
   VisiQuost — Design System
   Modern, dense, keyboard-friendly. Dark by default.
   ========================================================= */

:root {
  /* Palette — Dark (default) */
  --bg: #0b0f19;
  --bg-1: #111827;
  --bg-2: #1a2233;
  --bg-3: #232f45;
  --bg-hover: #2a374f;
  --fg: #f1f5f9;
  --fg-2: #cbd5e1;
  --fg-3: #94a3b8;
  --fg-4: #64748b;
  --border: #243044;
  --border-strong: #334155;

  --primary: #a855f7;
  --primary-2: #9333ea;
  --primary-fg: #ffffff;
  --primary-soft: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.14);

  --accent: #38bdf8;
  --accent-2: #0ea5e9;
  --accent-soft: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.14);

  --ok: #34d399;
  --ok-soft: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.14);
  --warn: #fbbf24;
  --warn-soft: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.14);
  --danger: #f87171;
  --danger-soft: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.14);

  /* Spacing scale */
  --s-1: 4px;
  --s-2: 8px;
  --s-3: 12px;
  --s-4: 16px;
  --s-5: 20px;
  --s-6: 24px;
  --s-8: 32px;
  --s-10: 40px;

  /* Radii */
  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r-md: 10px;
  --r-lg: 14px;
  --r-xl: 20px;

  /* Shadows */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  --shadow-glow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary-soft);

  /* Type */
  --font: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Consolas, monospace;

  /* Motion */
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --dur-fast: 120ms;
  --dur-med: 200ms;
}

/* Light theme */
[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg: #f8fafc;
  --bg-1: #ffffff;
  --bg-2: #ffffff;
  --bg-3: #f1f5f9;
  --bg-hover: #e2e8f0;
  --fg: #0f172a;
  --fg-2: #334155;
  --fg-3: #64748b;
  --fg-4: #94a3b8;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
  --border-strong: #cbd5e1;
  --primary-fg: #ffffff;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.08);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(15,23,42,0.12);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }

/* Top-of-page network progress bar. Vercel/GitHub-style — 2px slim, JARVIS-blue,
   only shown while API requests are in flight. Zero DOM cost when idle. */
#vq-progress-bar {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; width: 0%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--primary));
  z-index: 9999; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent);
  transition: width 400ms ease-out, opacity 200ms ease-out;
}
#vq-progress-bar.active { width: 70%; opacity: 1; transition: width 8s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.9, 0.1, 1), opacity 200ms; }
#vq-progress-bar.finish { width: 100%; opacity: 0; transition: width 200ms ease, opacity 400ms ease 100ms; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #vq-progress-bar { transition: opacity 100ms; }
  #vq-progress-bar.active { width: 100%; }
}

/* Smooth theme swap — background + color transition when data-theme changes.
   Guarded by html.theme-switching (set for 180ms during toggle) so it doesn't
   run for every hover/state change. */
html.theme-switching *,
html.theme-switching *::before,
html.theme-switching *::after {
  transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease !important;
}
body {
  font-family: var(--font);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}
/* Ativado apos login pra travar o viewport (CRM padrao com sidebars + main scroll). */
body.app-active { height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; }

/* Heading hierarchy — differentiated weights + explicit bottom margins.
   Airy: h1/h2/h3 all breathe; .card-header h3 collapses margin so cards stay tight. */
h1, h2, h3, h4 { margin: 0 0 var(--s-4); letter-spacing: -0.015em; }
h1 { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: var(--s-6); }
h2 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: var(--s-5); }
h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: var(--s-3); }
h4 { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
     color: var(--fg-3); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: var(--s-2); }

.card-header h3, .page-header h2 { margin-bottom: 0; }

code, kbd { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.85em; background: var(--bg-3); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }
kbd { border: 1px solid var(--border); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--border); }

.hidden { display: none !important; }
.subtle { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.88em; }
.error { color: var(--danger); min-height: 1.2em; margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.88em; }

/* Meetings page — day-bucketed list, Google Calendar-inspired layout.
   Bucket header separates Today / Tomorrow / This week / Later. */
#meetings-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.meeting-bucket-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-3); margin-top: 8px;
}
.meeting-bucket-header:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.meeting-count {
  background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-2);
  padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.85em;
  letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; font-weight: 600;
}
.meeting-item {
  padding: 10px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: background var(--dur-fast);
}
.meeting-item:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
.meeting-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.meeting-icon {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--accent-soft); font-size: 15px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.meeting-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.meeting-body strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.meeting-now { background: var(--accent-soft); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); padding-left: 8px; }
.meeting-now .meeting-icon { background: var(--accent); color: white; animation: newBadgePulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }

/* Tasks page — bucketed list (Overdue / Today / Tomorrow / Week / Later / No due / Done)
   with priority icons and click-to-complete checkbox. Todoist/Linear-inspired. */
#task-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.task-bucket-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 4px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--fg-3); margin-top: 10px;
}
.task-bucket-header:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.task-count {
  background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-2);
  padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.85em;
  letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; font-weight: 600;
}
.task-item { padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background var(--dur-fast); }
.task-item:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
.task-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.task-check {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--border);
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 2px; flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--ok); transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.task-check:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ok); background: var(--ok-soft); }
.task-check:disabled { background: var(--ok-soft); border-color: var(--ok); cursor: default; }
.task-prio { font-size: 0.95em; width: 18px; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }
.task-prio-urgent { filter: hue-rotate(-10deg); }
.task-prio-high { color: var(--warn, orange); }
.task-prio-low { opacity: 0.55; }
.task-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.task-title { font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.task-meta { font-size: 0.85em; color: var(--fg-3); }
.task-overdue { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 600; }
.task-done .task-title { text-decoration: line-through; color: var(--fg-3); }
.task-done .task-prio { opacity: 0.4; }

/* Activity feed — timeline entries with colored kind icons + translated labels */
#activity-feed { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.activity-item { padding: 8px 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: background var(--dur-fast); }
.activity-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.activity-item:hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
.activity-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.activity-icon {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 13px; user-select: none;
}
.activity-icon.act-good { background: var(--ok-soft); }
.activity-icon.act-info { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.activity-icon.act-warn { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); }
.activity-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.activity-line { font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1.4; }
.activity-subj { color: var(--fg-2); font-weight: 500; }
.activity-summary { color: var(--fg-3); }
.activity-when { font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--fg-3); margin-top: 1px; }

/* ================= BUTTONS ================= */
button { font-family: var(--font); font-size: 0.92em; }
.btn-primary, button.primary, .form > button[type="submit"] {
  padding: 9px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-2) 100%);
  color: var(--primary-fg);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast), box-shadow var(--dur-fast);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.btn-primary:hover, button.primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }
.btn-lg { padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 1em; width: 100%; }
.btn-sm { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 0.85em; }

/* Secondary — filled neutral. Use for cancel/dismiss next to a primary. */
.btn-secondary, button.secondary {
  padding: 9px 16px;
  background: var(--bg-hover);
  color: var(--fg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast), border-color var(--dur-fast), transform var(--dur-fast);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn-secondary:hover, button.secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-3); border-color: var(--fg-4); }
.btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

/* Ghost — outlined, empty. Use for tertiary/less-important actions. */
.btn-ghost, button.ghost {
  padding: 9px 16px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--fg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast), border-color var(--dur-fast);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn-ghost:hover, button.ghost:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: var(--primary); }

.icon-btn {
  background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--fg-3);
  cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  transition: background var(--dur-fast), color var(--dur-fast);
  font-size: 0.95em;
}
.icon-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-hover); }

.linkish {
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0; font: inherit;
}
.linkish:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.chip {
  padding: 5px 12px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--fg-2); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85em;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.chip:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }
.chip.active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-fg); border-color: var(--primary); }

.pill {
  display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

/* ================= AUTH ================= */
.auth-view {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;

.auth-hero {

}

.auth-card {

  flex: 1; padding: 10px; background: transparent; border: none;
  color: var(--fg-3); cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font-weight: 500; transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.tab.active { background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--fg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
.form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--s-4); }
.form label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: 0.85em; gap: 6px;
              color: var(--fg-3); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

/* Global form control styling — single source of truth for inputs/selects/textareas.
   Applied broadly, then locked out from Jarvis composer which has its own compact style. */
input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[type="password"], input[type="number"],
input[type="search"], input[type="tel"], input[type="url"], input[type="date"],
input[type="datetime-local"], input[type="time"], select, textarea {
  padding: 11px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--fg);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font-size: 0.95em;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast), box-shadow var(--dur-fast), background var(--dur-fast);
}
input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
  outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
  background: var(--bg-2);
}
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder { color: var(--fg-4); opacity: 1; }
input:disabled, select:disabled, textarea:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }
textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 72px; }
.auth-demo {
  margin-top: 24px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font-size: 0.85em; display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.auth-demo code { background: var(--bg-3); }

/* ================= APP LAYOUT ================= */
.app-view {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 380px;
  height: 100vh;
  transition: grid-template-columns var(--dur-med) var(--ease);
}
body.jarvis-collapsed .app-view { grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 0; }
body.jarvis-collapsed .jarvis-panel { display: none; }

/* Reopen tab (only visible when collapsed on desktop) */
.jarvis-reopen {
  display: none;
  position: fixed; right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 40;
  width: 40px; height: 56px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
  color: var(--primary-fg); border: none;
  border-top-left-radius: var(--r-md); border-bottom-left-radius: var(--r-md);
  font-size: 1.4em; cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-reopen:hover { transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(-3px); }
body.jarvis-collapsed .jarvis-reopen { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

/* ================= SIDEBAR ================= */
.sidebar {
  background: var(--bg-1);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 20px 14px;
  gap: 8px;
}
.brand-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 8px 12px; }
.brand-mark { flex-shrink: 0; }
.brand { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1em; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

.cmdk-hint {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg-3); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.88em;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.cmdk-hint:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); }
.cmdk-hint kbd { font-size: 0.78em; padding: 1px 5px; background: var(--bg-3); border-color: var(--border-strong); }

.nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; }
.nav-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  text-align: left; padding: 9px 12px;
  background: none; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg-2); cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.93em; font-weight: 500; font-family: inherit;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.nav-item .ico { font-size: 1.05em; width: 20px; text-align: center; opacity: 0.85; }
.nav-item:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); }
.nav-item.active {
  background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.nav-item.active .ico { opacity: 1; }
.nav-badge {
  margin-left: auto; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; min-width: 20px; text-align: center;
}
.nav-item.active .nav-badge { background: var(--primary); color: white; }

.nav-more { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding-left: 6px; border-left: 2px solid var(--border); margin-left: 8px; }
.nav-more-toggle { color: var(--fg-3); }
.nav-more-toggle.open .ico { transform: rotate(90deg); display: inline-block; }

.sidebar-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
/* On-device footprint — signature element. Reinforces "you own your data".
   Deliberately quiet: no gradient, hairline border, monospace numbers,
   subtle green pulse. The point is presence, not attention. */
.local-footprint {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px;
  background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--ok);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: default;
}
.lf-badge {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ok);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.lf-stats {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
  font-size: 0.78em; line-height: 1.35;
  min-width: 0; flex: 1;
}
.lf-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg-2); font-size: 1.05em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.lf-unit { color: var(--fg-4); }

.user-chip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px; background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}
.avatar {
  width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
  color: white; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85em; text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.user-info { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.user-email { font-size: 0.83em; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.workspace-name { font-size: 0.75em; }

.io-buttons { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.menu-btn {
  text-align: left; padding: 7px 10px; background: none; border: none;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); color: var(--fg-2); cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85em; font-family: inherit; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.menu-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); }
.menu-btn.danger:hover { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }

/* ================= MAIN ================= */
.main { padding: 32px 40px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--bg); }
.page { display: none; animation: fadeIn 200ms var(--ease); }
.page:not(.hidden) { display: block; }
/* Airy layout: each page owns its own vertical rhythm. Direct-child stacking. */
.page > * + * { margin-top: var(--s-6); }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

.page-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--s-8); gap: var(--s-4); flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.filter-row { display: flex; gap: var(--s-2); margin: var(--s-3) 0 var(--s-5); flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ================= ONBOARDING ================= */
.onboarding-card {
  display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-soft) 0%, var(--accent-soft) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  animation: fadeIn 300ms var(--ease);
}
.onboarding-icon { font-size: 3em; }
.onboarding-body { flex: 1; }
.onboarding-body h3 { font-size: 1.3em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.onb-steps {
  list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 14px 0 8px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
}
.onb-steps li {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
}
.onb-steps li.done { opacity: 0.55; }
.onb-check {
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--primary); color: white;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85em; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.onb-steps li.done .onb-check::before { content: "✓"; }
.onb-steps li.done .onb-check { font-size: 0; }
.onb-steps li span:nth-of-type(2) { flex: 1; font-size: 0.92em; }

/* ================= CARDS ================= */
.card {
  background: var(--bg-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: var(--s-6);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast), box-shadow var(--dur-fast);
}
.card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
               gap: var(--s-3); margin-bottom: var(--s-4); }

/* ================= KPIs ================= */
.kpi-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
           gap: var(--s-4); }
@keyframes vq-kpi-fade {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.kpi {
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: var(--s-5); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); transition: transform var(--dur-med), box-shadow var(--dur-med);
  animation: vq-kpi-fade 320ms ease-out both;
}
.kpi:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0ms; }
.kpi:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 40ms; }
.kpi:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 80ms; }
.kpi:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
.kpi:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 160ms; }
.kpi:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .kpi { animation: none; } }
.kpi:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
.kpi::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
  opacity: 0.7;
}
/* Per-KPI color coding: primary/pipeline vs revenue vs risk. Add data-kind on markup. */
.kpi[data-kind="revenue"]::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ok), var(--accent)); }
.kpi[data-kind="revenue"] .label { color: var(--ok); }
.kpi[data-kind="pipeline"]::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--primary)); }
.kpi[data-kind="pipeline"] .label { color: var(--accent); }
.kpi[data-kind="won"]::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--ok)); }
.kpi[data-kind="won"] .label { color: var(--primary); }
.kpi[data-kind="risk"]::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--warn), var(--danger)); }
.kpi[data-kind="risk"] .label { color: var(--warn); }

.kpi .value { font-size: 2em; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.15; }
.kpi .label { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.75em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
              margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 700; }
.kpi .delta { font-size: 0.8em; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--fg-3); }
.kpi .delta.up { color: var(--ok); }
.kpi .delta.down { color: var(--danger); }

/* Skeleton loading — used while data is being fetched. Subtle shimmer. */
@keyframes vq-shimmer {
  0% { background-position: -200px 0; }
  100% { background-position: calc(200px + 100%) 0; }
}
.skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-2) 0px, var(--bg-3) 40px, var(--bg-2) 80px);
  background-size: 200px 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  animation: vq-shimmer 1.2s infinite linear;
  display: block;
}
.skeleton-line { height: 12px; margin: 8px 0; }
.skeleton-line.w-40 { width: 40%; }
.skeleton-line.w-60 { width: 60%; }
.skeleton-line.w-80 { width: 80%; }
.skeleton-line.w-full { width: 100%; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .skeleton { animation: none; } }

/* Hero KPI — 5-second-rule landing card. Spans two columns, more prominent. */
.kpi-hero {
  grid-column: span 2;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-1), var(--bg-2));
  border-color: var(--accent);
}
.kpi-hero::before { height: 4px; opacity: 1; }
.kpi-hero .value { font-size: 2.6em !important; color: var(--fg); }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .kpi-hero { grid-column: span 1; } }

.grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: var(--s-5); }
@media (max-width: 1400px) { .grid-2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* ================= TABLES ================= */
.search {
  width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--fg); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  margin-bottom: 14px; font-size: 0.93em;
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast);
}
.search:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow); }
.table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.table th, .table td { padding: 11px 14px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.9em; }
.table th { background: var(--bg-2); font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-3); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75em; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
.table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }
.table th .sort-ind { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; margin-left: 4px; }
@keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

/* Row-clickable — premium hover: subtle indent + accent border-left on hover */
.row-clickable { cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--dur-fast), box-shadow var(--dur-fast); position: relative; }
.row-clickable:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.row-clickable:hover td:first-child { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
/* Keyboard-nav focus row — j/k or Arrow keys move this marker */
.row-clickable.row-focus { background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent); }
.row-clickable.row-focus .row-qa-wrap { opacity: 1; }

/* Local status indicator in sidebar — pulsing green dot + tag confirming
   the "100% local" promise. Distinctive vs cloud-based CRMs. */
.local-dot {
  display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--ok); margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: middle;
  animation: vq-local-pulse 2.4s infinite ease-in-out;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
}
@keyframes vq-local-pulse {
  0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.5); }
  50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .local-dot { animation: none; } }
.local-tag {
  margin-left: 8px; font-size: 0.65em; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ok);
  border: 1px solid var(--ok); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; opacity: 0.75;
}

/* NEW badge — appears next to entities created in the last 24h. Subtle
   accent pill so recent additions stand out in a long list without noise. */
.new-badge {
  display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; padding: 1px 6px;
  font-size: 0.62em; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-radius: 3px; vertical-align: middle; text-transform: uppercase;
  animation: newBadgePulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes newBadgePulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; }
  50% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-soft); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .new-badge { animation: none; } }
@media print { .new-badge { display: none; } }

/* Recently-viewed strip — quick re-access to entities the user opened lately */
.recent-viewed {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 8px 0 12px 0; font-size: 0.85em;
}
.recent-label { color: var(--fg-4); font-size: 0.75em; text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 700; }
.recent-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 10px 4px 6px; border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--fg-2);
  cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.recent-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-3); }

/* Row avatar — initials chip colored by hash of name, for identity + scannability */
.row-avatar {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 700; color: white;
  margin-right: 10px; vertical-align: middle; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none;
}

/* Row quick-actions (email/call icons on hover) — hidden by default, fade in on row hover */
.row-qa-wrap {
  margin-left: 8px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--dur-fast); display: inline-flex; gap: 6px;
}
.row-clickable:hover .row-qa-wrap { opacity: 1; }
.row-qa {
  display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9em; line-height: 1;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.row-qa:hover { background: var(--bg-3); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ================= PAGINATION ================= */
.pagination {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 4px; font-size: 0.85em; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pagination .chip { padding: 4px 10px; }
.pagination-count { color: var(--fg-3); margin-right: auto; }

/* ================= LISTS ================= */
/* Pipeline chart — labels rendered as HTML row below the SVG bars,
   so they don't get horizontally stretched by preserveAspectRatio="none". */
.pipe-chart-labels {
  display: flex; margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 2px;
  font-size: 0.78em; color: var(--fg-2);
}
.pipe-chart-label {
  flex: 1; text-align: center; overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 0 4px;
}

.list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.list li:not(.empty) {
  padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 0.95em;
}
.list li:not(.empty):last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.list li:not(.empty):hover { background: var(--bg-2); }
.list li { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 0.92em; }
.list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.list .empty {
  color: var(--fg-3); padding: 24px 12px; text-align: center;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  font-size: 0.93em;
}
.list .empty .empty-ico { font-size: 1.8em; opacity: 0.6; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.list .empty .empty-title { color: var(--fg-2); font-weight: 500; }
.list .empty .empty-hint { color: var(--fg-4); font-size: 0.85em; }
.list .empty.good .empty-title { color: var(--ok); }
.task-list li { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
.task-list button { padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 0.82em; }
.task-list .task-meta { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 0.8em; color: var(--fg-3); }

/* ================= STATUS PILLS ================= */
.flex-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.status-pill {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-2);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.status-pill.qualified { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.status-pill.contacted { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
.status-pill.new { background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-3); }
.status-pill.unqualified { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.status-pill.converted { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
.status-pill.open, .status-pill.pending { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.status-pill.won { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.status-pill.lost { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.status-pill.done { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }

/* ================= JARVIS FULL-SCREEN (Manus-like) ================= */
.jarvis-hero-layout {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
  gap: 20px; height: calc(100vh - 90px); max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
}
.jarvis-hero-layout.drop-target::after {
  content: "📎 Solte para enviar / Drop to upload";
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: var(--primary-soft); border: 3px dashed var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--primary); pointer-events: none;
  animation: fadeIn 150ms var(--ease);
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .jarvis-hero-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .jarvis-convos { display: none; }
}
.jarvis-convos {
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.jarvis-convos-header {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88em; color: var(--fg-3);
  text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
#jarvis-convos-list { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
#jarvis-convos-list li {
  padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.88em; border-bottom: none; transition: background var(--dur-fast);
  overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
}
#jarvis-convos-list li:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }
#jarvis-convos-list li.active { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); font-weight: 500; }

.jarvis-hero {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%; gap: 16px;
}
.jarvis-hero-log {
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 20px 4px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
}
.jarvis-hero-welcome {
  text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px;
  animation: fadeIn 300ms var(--ease);
}
.hero-mark {
  font-size: 3.5em; margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
  -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
}
.jarvis-hero-welcome h2 { font-size: 2em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.hero-examples {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;
  justify-content: center; margin-top: 24px;
}
.hero-examples .qbtn { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 0.9em; }
.jarvis-hero .jarvis-msg { max-width: 80%; font-size: 0.95em; padding: 14px 18px; }
.jarvis-hero-form {
  display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-end;
  padding: 12px; background: var(--bg-1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.jarvis-hero-form textarea {
  flex: 1; resize: none; padding: 10px 14px;
  background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--fg);
  font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.5;
  min-height: 24px; max-height: 200px;
}
.jarvis-hero-form textarea:focus { outline: none; }
.jarvis-hero-form button[type="submit"] {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-2));
  color: white; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.2em; flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-hero-form button[type="submit"]:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }
.jarvis-mic {
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1em; flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-mic:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); }
.jarvis-mic.recording {
  background: var(--danger); color: white; border-color: var(--danger);
  animation: pulse 1.2s infinite;
}
.jarvis-context-chip {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--primary-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--r-md);
  font-size: 0.9em; color: var(--primary);
  animation: fadeIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
.jarvis-suggestions {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
  padding: 0 4px;
}
.jarvis-suggestions .qbtn { font-size: 0.82em; }

/* Convo list item — delete button on hover */
#jarvis-convos-list li { position: relative; padding-right: 28px; }
.convo-del {
  position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--fg-3);
  cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 0.9em; transition: opacity var(--dur-fast);
}
.convo-rename-input {
  width: calc(100% - 30px); padding: 2px 6px;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--primary);
  color: var(--fg); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.88em; font-family: inherit;
}
.convo-rename-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow); }
#jarvis-convos-list li:hover .convo-del { opacity: 1; }
.convo-del:hover { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }

/* ================= TYPING INDICATOR ================= */
.jarvis-typing {
  display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); align-self: flex-start;
  animation: fadeIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
.jarvis-typing span {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--primary); opacity: 0.4;
  animation: typing-bounce 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.jarvis-typing span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.jarvis-typing span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
@keyframes typing-bounce {
  0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
  30% { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 1; }
}

/* Favorites */
.convo-star {
  position: absolute; right: 26px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--fg-3);
  cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.4; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 0.9em;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-fast);
}
#jarvis-convos-list li:hover .convo-star,
.convo-star.starred { opacity: 1; }
.convo-star.starred { color: var(--warn); }

/* Convo export */
.convo-export {
  position: absolute; right: 46px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: none; border: none; color: var(--fg-3);
  cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 0.8em;
  transition: opacity var(--dur-fast);
}
#jarvis-convos-list li:hover .convo-export { opacity: 1; }
#jarvis-convos-list li { padding-right: 68px; }

/* ================= HERO MARKDOWN ================= */
.jarvis-hero .jarvis-msg { position: relative; padding-right: 40px; }
.jarvis-hero .jarvis-msg.user { padding-right: 18px; }
.jarvis-hero .md-h2 { font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; margin: 12px 0 6px; }
.jarvis-hero .md-h3 { font-size: 1.02em; font-weight: 600; margin: 10px 0 4px; color: var(--primary); }
.jarvis-hero .md-list { margin: 4px 0 8px; padding-left: 20px; }
.jarvis-hero .md-list li { margin: 2px 0; }
.jarvis-hero code {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.88em;
}
[data-theme="light"] .jarvis-hero code { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }
.msg-copy {
  position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;
  background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.95em; opacity: 0.4; transition: opacity var(--dur-fast);
  padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
}
.jarvis-msg:hover .msg-copy { opacity: 1; }
.msg-copy:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

/* ================= AGENT PLAN CARDS ================= */
.jarvis-hero-turn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.plan-card {
  padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-md);
  align-self: flex-start; max-width: 90%;
  animation: fadeIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
.plan-header {
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88em; margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--fg-3); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.plan-step {
  display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.plan-step:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
.plan-step-mark {
  width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8em; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.plan-step.ok .plan-step-mark { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.plan-step.warn .plan-step-mark { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }
.plan-step-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.plan-step-title { font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: 500; }
.plan-step-tools {
  margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75em;
}
.plan-step-tools code { padding: 1px 5px; margin-right: 4px; }

/* ================= DEVICE FILES LIST ================= */
.device-files {
  list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 16px 0 0;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 6px;
}
.device-file-item {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast); font-size: 0.85em;
}
.device-file-item:hover { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--bg-hover); }
.device-file-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: 8px; }

/* ================= QUICK ACTIONS ================= */
.quick-actions {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.qa-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--fg); border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 0.85em;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast); font-family: inherit;
}
.qa-btn:hover { background: var(--primary-soft); border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }

/* ================= TAG PILLS ================= */
.tag-pill {
  display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.72em; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 4px;
  background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-2);
}
.tag-pill.color-blue { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.18); color: var(--accent); }
.tag-pill.color-green { background: rgba(52,211,153,0.18); color: var(--ok); }
.tag-pill.color-purple { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
.tag-pill.color-orange { background: rgba(251,146,60,0.18); color: #fb923c; }
.tag-pill.color-pink { background: rgba(244,114,182,0.18); color: #f472b6; }
.tag-pill.color-red { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
.tag-pill.color-yellow { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); }

/* ================= BULK TOOLBAR ================= */
.bulk-toolbar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: var(--primary-soft); border: 1px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 0.9em;
  animation: bulkToolbarIn 180ms ease-out;
}
@keyframes bulkToolbarIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .bulk-toolbar { animation: none; } }
.bulk-count-wrap {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px;
  padding: 3px 10px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-fg);
  border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600;
}
.bulk-count-wrap .bulk-count-label { font-size: 0.85em; opacity: 0.9; font-weight: 500; }
#contacts-bulk-count, #companies-bulk-count { font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary-fg); }
.bulk-toolbar .bulk-danger { color: var(--danger); }
.bulk-toolbar .bulk-danger:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); border-color: var(--danger); }
.bulk-toolbar .linkish { margin-left: auto; }

/* Inbox list */
#inbox-list li { padding: 12px 8px; cursor: default; }
#inbox-list li.unread { background: var(--primary-soft); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding-left: 12px; }
#inbox-list .inbox-when { font-size: 0.75em; color: var(--fg-3); }

/* ================= JARVIS PANEL ================= */
.jarvis-panel {
  background: var(--bg-1);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: 16px; gap: 12px; min-height: 0;
}
.jarvis-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0 4px; }
.jarvis-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05em; }
.jarvis-pulse {
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--ok);
  animation: pulse 2s infinite;
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153, 0.55); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(52,211,153, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153, 0); }
}

.jarvis-log { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 2px; min-height: 0; }

.jarvis-welcome {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-soft) 0%, var(--accent-soft) 100%);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-md);
}
.welcome-icon { font-size: 1.6em; }
.welcome-text strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.welcome-text p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.85em; color: var(--fg-2); line-height: 1.45; }

.jarvis-nudges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; }
.jarvis-nudge {
  padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 0.78em;
  background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.35); border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-nudge:hover { background: rgba(56,189,248,0.25); }
.jarvis-nudge.warn { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); border-color: rgba(248,113,113,0.4); }

.jarvis-quickies { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; padding: 0 2px; }
.qbtn {
  padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 0.78em; background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg-2); cursor: pointer; transition: all var(--dur-fast);
}
.qbtn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--primary); }

.jarvis-msg {
  padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-md); max-width: 90%;
  white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
  font-size: 0.88em; line-height: 1.5;
  animation: msgIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
@keyframes msgIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
.jarvis-msg.user {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-2) 100%);
  color: white; align-self: flex-end;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 4px;
}
.jarvis-msg.assistant {
  background: var(--bg-2); align-self: flex-start;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom-left-radius: 4px;
}
.jarvis-msg.assistant strong { color: var(--primary); }
.jarvis-msg.fallback { border-color: var(--warn); }

.jarvis-form { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.jarvis-form input {
  flex: 1; padding: 10px 14px;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--fg); border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-size: 0.9em;
  transition: border-color var(--dur-fast);
  font-family: inherit;
}
.jarvis-form input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow); }
.jarvis-form button {
  padding: 10px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-2) 100%);
  color: white; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1em;
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-form button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

/* ================= KANBAN ================= */
/* Kanban scroll wrapper — CSS-only fade edges + JS-driven visibility */
.kanban-scroll-wrap { position: relative; }
.kanban-scroll-wrap::before,
.kanban-scroll-wrap::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 12px; width: 40px;
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--dur-fast);
}
.kanban-scroll-wrap::before { left: 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--bg), transparent); }
.kanban-scroll-wrap::after { right: 0; background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--bg), transparent); }
.kanban-scroll-wrap.can-scroll-left::before { opacity: 1; }
.kanban-scroll-wrap.can-scroll-right::after { opacity: 1; }

.kanban-scroll-btn {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 3; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  color: var(--fg-2); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.1em; line-height: 1;
  display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transition: background var(--dur-fast), transform var(--dur-fast);
}
.kanban-scroll-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-hover); color: var(--fg); transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.06); }
.kanban-scroll-btn-right { right: 8px; }
.kanban-scroll-btn-left { left: 8px; }
.kanban-scroll-wrap.can-scroll-right .kanban-scroll-btn-right { display: flex; }
.kanban-scroll-wrap.can-scroll-left .kanban-scroll-btn-left { display: flex; }

.kanban-board {
  display: flex; gap: 12px;
  overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}
.kanban-col {
  min-width: 260px; max-width: 280px; flex: 0 0 auto;
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  max-height: calc(100vh - 180px);
}
.kanban-col h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 0.85em; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
.kanban-col.drag-over {
  border: 2px dashed var(--primary); background: var(--primary-soft);
  transform: scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
}
.kanban-col.drag-over h4 { color: var(--primary); }
.kanban-col.drag-over .kanban-cards::after {
  content: ""; display: block; height: 40px; margin-top: 6px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--primary); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08);
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .kanban-col.drag-over { transform: none; } }
.kanban-col.collapsed { min-width: 56px; max-width: 56px; }
.kanban-col.collapsed .kanban-cards,
.kanban-col.collapsed .kanban-total,
.kanban-col.collapsed h4 span:first-child { display: none; }
.kanban-col.collapsed h4 { writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-orientation: mixed; justify-content: center; }
.kanban-col .wip-limit-hit { color: var(--danger); }
.kanban-total { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.78em; }
.kanban-col .expand-toggle {
  align-self: center; margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 3px 10px; background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg-3); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.75em;
  font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast), border-color var(--dur-fast), color var(--dur-fast);
}
.kanban-col .expand-toggle:hover {
  background: var(--bg-hover); border-color: var(--fg-4); color: var(--fg-2);
}
.kanban-cards { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; }
.kanban-card {
  background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 10px 12px;
  font-size: 0.88em; cursor: grab;
  transition: all var(--dur-fast);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.kanban-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: var(--primary); }
.kanban-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }
/* Drag-in-flight state — fade + rotate slightly for tactile feedback */
.kanban-card[draggable="true"]:active { opacity: 0.75; transform: rotate(-1.5deg) scale(1.02); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
/* Keyboard-grabbed state — space-key equivalent of a drag pickup */
.kanban-card-grabbed {
  outline: 2px dashed var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.kanban-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.kanban-card .name { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.kanban-card .amount { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.82em; }
.kanban-card .opp-prob { height: 4px; background: var(--bg-3); border-radius: 2px; margin-top: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.kanban-card .opp-prob-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent)); }
.kanban-card .opp-close { font-size: 0.75em; margin-top: 4px; }

/* ================= DRAWER ================= */
.drawer {
  position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 460px; max-width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  background: var(--bg-1); border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 24px 28px; overflow-y: auto;
  z-index: 25;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 20px;
  animation: slideIn 250ms var(--ease);
}
@keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateX(100%); } to { transform: none; } }
.drawer.hidden { display: none; }
.drawer-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  position: sticky; top: -24px; margin: -24px -28px 0; padding: 16px 28px;
  background: var(--bg-1); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  z-index: 2; backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.drawer-header h3 { margin: 0; }
.drawer-body dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr; gap: 8px 14px; margin: 0; }
.drawer-body dt { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.82em; font-weight: 500; }
.drawer-body dd { margin: 0; word-break: break-word; font-size: 0.9em; }
.drawer-body dd.editable {
  cursor: text; padding: 2px 4px; margin: -2px -4px; border-radius: 4px;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast);
}
.drawer-body dd.editable:hover { background: var(--bg-3); }
.inline-edit-input {
  width: 100%; padding: 4px 6px; background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary); color: var(--fg); border-radius: 4px;
  font: inherit; font-size: 0.9em;
}
.inline-edit-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow); }
.drawer-section h4 { margin: 0 0 10px; }
.drawer-inline-form { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.drawer-inline-form input {
  flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--bg-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--fg); border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-family: inherit;
}
.drawer .list li { font-size: 0.86em; padding: 8px 0; }

/* ================= MODAL ================= */
.modal {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.72);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  z-index: 30; animation: fadeIn 180ms var(--ease);
}
.modal-inner {
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 24px;
  min-width: 400px; max-width: 560px; width: 92%;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  animation: modalIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
@keyframes modalIn { from { transform: scale(0.96); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.modal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; }

/* ================= CMDK (command palette) ================= */
.cmdk {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  padding-top: 15vh;
  background: rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  animation: fadeIn 150ms var(--ease);
}
.cmdk-inner {
  width: min(90vw, 620px);
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: modalIn 200ms var(--ease);
}
#cmdk-input {
  width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px;
  background: transparent; border: none;
  color: var(--fg); font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
#cmdk-input:focus { outline: none; }
.cmdk-results { max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; }
.cmdk-item {
  padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  transition: background var(--dur-fast);
  font-size: 0.92em;
}
.cmdk-item:hover, .cmdk-item.active { background: var(--primary-soft); color: var(--primary); }
.cmdk-item .kind { color: var(--fg-3); font-size: 0.78em; margin-left: auto; }
.cmdk-footer {
  display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--bg-2);
  font-size: 0.75em;
}
.cmdk-group { padding: 8px 20px 4px; font-size: 0.7em; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--fg-4); font-weight: 600; }

/* ================= HELP MODAL ================= */
.help-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.help-group h4 { margin: 0 0 8px; }
.help-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 0; font-size: 0.85em; }
.help-row kbd { font-size: 0.75em; padding: 2px 6px; }
.help-row span { color: var(--fg-2); }
.help-row em { color: var(--fg-2); font-style: normal; background: var(--bg-2); padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.8em; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .help-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* ================= TOASTS ================= */
.toast-host {
  position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px;
  z-index: 50; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.toast {
  padding: 12px 18px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  color: var(--fg); font-size: 0.9em;
  animation: toastIn 250ms var(--ease);
  border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
  pointer-events: auto;
  min-width: 240px; max-width: 400px;
}
@keyframes toastIn { from { transform: translateX(20px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.toast.success { border-left-color: var(--ok); }
.toast.error { border-left-color: var(--danger); }
.toast.warn { border-left-color: var(--warn); }

/* ================= WORKFLOWS ================= */
.workflow-card {
  background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.workflow-card .wf-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; }
.workflow-card pre {
  background: var(--bg-2); padding: 12px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  font-size: 0.8em; overflow-x: auto; max-height: 220px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.workflow-card .wf-editor textarea {
  width: 100%; min-height: 130px; background: var(--bg-2);
  color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.82em;
}

/* ================= FOCUS MODE ================= */
body.focus-mode .app-view { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
body.focus-mode .sidebar, body.focus-mode .jarvis-panel { display: none; }
body.focus-mode .main { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }

/* ================= MOBILE HAMBURGER ================= */
.jarvis-fab {
  display: none; position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px; z-index: 25;
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
  color: white; border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1.5em; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  transition: transform var(--dur-fast);
}
.jarvis-fab:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }
body.jarvis-open .jarvis-fab { display: none; }

.hamburger {
  display: none; position: fixed; top: 12px; left: 12px; z-index: 60;
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.2em; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.sidebar-scrim {
  display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
}

/* ================= RESPONSIVE ================= */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .app-view { grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr 340px; }
}
@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .app-view { grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; }
  .jarvis-panel {
    position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 92vw; max-width: 400px;
    z-index: 25; transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform 200ms var(--ease);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); display: flex;
  }
  body.jarvis-open .jarvis-panel { transform: none; }
  #jarvis-close-mobile { display: inline-flex !important; }
  #jarvis-collapse { display: none !important; }  /* desktop-only collapse */
  .jarvis-fab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .auth-view { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .auth-hero { display: none; }
  .auth-card { padding: 24px 20px 32px; border-left: none; }
  .auth-inner { max-width: 100%; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .auth-title { font-size: 26px; }
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .app-view { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .hamburger { display: block; }
  .sidebar {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 260px; z-index: 30;
    transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 200ms var(--ease);
  }
  body.sidebar-open .sidebar { transform: none; }
  body.sidebar-open .sidebar-scrim { display: block; }
  .main { padding: 60px 16px 16px; }
  .kpi-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .grid-2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .modal-inner { min-width: 0; }
  .drawer { width: 100vw; }
}

/* Scrollbars */
::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--bg-3); border-radius: 5px; border: 2px solid var(--bg); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--border-strong); }

/* Print styles — hide chrome, keep content. User can Ctrl+P the dashboard. */
@media print {
  .sidebar, .jarvis-panel, .jarvis-fab, .jarvis-reopen, #hamburger, #cmdk,
  #modal, #drawer, .toast-host, .cmdk-hint, .io-buttons { display: none !important; }
  body { overflow: visible !important; height: auto !important; }
  .app-view { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; }
  .main { padding: 0 !important; overflow: visible !important; }
  .card, .kpi { box-shadow: none !important; border: 1px solid #000 !important; break-inside: avoid; }
  .page-header { border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 8px; }
  * { color: #000 !important; background: #fff !important; }
}

/* Visually-hidden but screen-reader-accessible. Use for labels on icon-only
   buttons where the emoji/character conveys meaning to sighted users. */
.sr-only {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px; height: 1px;
  padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap; border: 0;
}

/* Focus-visible outline — subtle purple ring for keyboard navigation.
   Doesn't fire on mouse click (focus-visible pseudo-class). A11y baseline. */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
/* Buttons already have their own hover — soften focus ring so it doesn't clash */
button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
/* Inputs already have box-shadow focus — kill outline to avoid double-ring */
input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}

/* Global reduced-motion: honor user's OS accessibility preference.
   Individual @media blocks above still fire, this is the safety net
   for anything I forgot to gate. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

```

function detectLang() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY);
  if (saved && DICT[saved]) return saved;
  const nav = (navigator.language || "en").toLowerCase();
  return nav.startsWith("pt") ? "pt" : "en";
}

const state = {
  token: localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY) || null,
  user: null,
  workspace: null,
  conversation_id: localStorage.getItem(CONV_KEY) || null,
  page: "dashboard",
  lang: detectLang(),
  theme: localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY) || "dark",
  taskFilter: "all",
  contactSearch: "",
  companySearch: "",
};

function t(key, ...args) {
  const val = DICT[state.lang]?.[key] ?? DICT.en[key] ?? key;
  return typeof val === "function" ? val(...args) : val;
}

function applyLang() {
  document.documentElement.lang = state.lang === "pt" ? "pt-BR" : "en";
  // Apply text to statically-labeled elements via data-i18n
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el => {
    const key = el.dataset.i18n;
    if (DICT[state.lang]?.[key] !== undefined) el.textContent = t(key);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n-ph]").forEach(el => {
    const key = el.dataset.i18nPh;
    if (DICT[state.lang]?.[key] !== undefined) el.setAttribute("placeholder", t(key));
  });
}

function applyTheme() {
  // Enable smooth cross-fade for the duration of the swap only.
  const html = document.documentElement;
  html.classList.add("theme-switching");
  html.setAttribute("data-theme", state.theme);
  localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, state.theme);
  setTimeout(() => html.classList.remove("theme-switching"), 220);
}

// ---------- HTTP ----------
// Top-of-page network progress bar — Vercel/GitHub style. Counts in-flight
// requests; slides in when >0, fades out on drain. Zero-cost when idle.
let _apiInflight = 0;
function _apiStart() {
  _apiInflight++;
  let bar = document.getElementById("vq-progress-bar");
  if (!bar) {
    bar = document.createElement("div");
    bar.id = "vq-progress-bar";
    document.body.appendChild(bar);
  }
  bar.classList.add("active");
}
function _apiEnd() {
  _apiInflight = Math.max(0, _apiInflight - 1);
  if (_apiInflight === 0) {
    const bar = document.getElementById("vq-progress-bar");
    if (bar) { bar.classList.remove("active"); bar.classList.add("finish"); setTimeout(() => bar.classList.remove("finish"), 400); }
  }
}

async function api(path, { method = "GET", body, headers = {} } = {}) {
  const opts = { method, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...headers } };
  if (state.token) opts.headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${state.token}`;
  if (body) opts.body = JSON.stringify(body);
  _apiStart();
  let resp;
  try {
    resp = await fetch(`${API}${path}`, opts);
  } catch (netErr) {
    _apiEnd();
    // Network failure — usually server down
    const err = new Error(state.lang === "pt"
      ? "Servidor offline. Verifique se o VisiQuost está rodando."
      : "Server offline. Check if VisiQuost is running.");
    err.status = 0;
    throw err;
  }
  if (resp.status === 204) return null;
  const text = await resp.text();
  const data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  if (!resp.ok) {
    if (resp.status === 401 && state.token && !path.startsWith("/auth/")) {
      clearToken();
      state.user = null;
      show("auth");
      const err = new Error(t("session_expired"));
      err.status = 401;
      throw err;
    }
    // Friendly messages per status
    const FRIENDLY = {
      400: state.lang === "pt" ? "Dados inválidos" : "Invalid data",
      403: state.lang === "pt" ? "Sem permissão" : "Not allowed",
      404: state.lang === "pt" ? "Não encontrado" : "Not found",
      409: state.lang === "pt" ? "Conflito (já existe?)" : "Conflict (already exists?)",
      413: state.lang === "pt" ? "Arquivo muito grande" : "File too large",
      429: state.lang === "pt" ? "Muitas requisições. Espere um pouco." : "Too many requests. Slow down.",
      500: state.lang === "pt" ? "Erro interno. Veja o log do servidor." : "Server error. Check the log.",
      503: state.lang === "pt" ? "Serviço indisponível" : "Service unavailable",
    };
    const detail = data?.detail || FRIENDLY[resp.status] || `HTTP ${resp.status}`;
    const err = new Error(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : JSON.stringify(detail));
    err.status = resp.status;
    err.data = data;
    _apiEnd();
    throw err;
  }
  _apiEnd();
  return data;
}

// ==================== TOASTS ====================
function toast(msg, kind = "info", ms = 3200) {
  const host = document.getElementById("toast-host");
  if (!host) { console.log("[toast]", msg); return; }
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = `toast ${kind}`;
  el.textContent = msg;
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = "0"; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, ms);
}

// Undo toast with 5s window — dispatched after a soft-delete
function toastUndo(label, kind, itemId) {
  const host = document.getElementById("toast-host");
  if (!host) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "toast";
  el.style.borderLeftColor = "var(--warn)";
  const undoLabel = state.lang === "pt" ? "Desfazer" : "Undo";
  el.innerHTML = `<span></span>&nbsp;&nbsp;<button class="linkish" style="font-weight:600;">${undoLabel}</button>`;
  el.querySelector("span").textContent = label;
  const btn = el.querySelector("button");
  btn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await api(`/restore/${kind}/${itemId}`, { method: "POST" });
      toast(state.lang === "pt" ? "↩ Restaurado" : "↩ Restored", "success", 1800);
      routes[state.page]?.();
    } catch (err) {
      toast(err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      el.remove();
    }
  });
  host.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(() => { el.style.opacity = "0"; setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 300); }, 5000);
}

// ---------- Auth ----------
function saveToken(tok) { state.token = tok; localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, tok); }
function clearToken() { state.token = null; localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY); localStorage.removeItem(CONV_KEY); state.conversation_id = null; }

async function tryRestoreSession() {
  if (!state.token) return false;
  try {
    state.user = await api("/auth/me");
    try {
      const wss = await api("/workspaces");
      state.workspace = wss?.[0] || null;
    } catch {}
    return true;
  } catch {
    clearToken();
    return false;
  }
}

function applyAuthI18n() {
  // Elementos com data-i18n="key" recebem t(key) direto — cobre hero, badge,
  // welcome, feature cards, stats, demo button. Extensivel: basta anotar
  // o elemento com o atributo.
  document.querySelectorAll(".auth-view [data-i18n]").forEach(el => {
    const key = el.dataset.i18n;
    const txt = t(key);
    if (txt) el.textContent = txt;
  });
  // Tabs (nao tem data-i18n pra permitir switch classes)
  const q = (sel, txt) => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (el) el.textContent = txt; };
  q('.tab[data-tab="login"]', t("auth_login_tab"));
  q('.tab[data-tab="register"]', t("auth_register_tab"));
  // Form labels — text node antes do <input>
  document.querySelectorAll("#login-form label, #register-form label").forEach(label => {
    const inp = label.querySelector("input");
    if (!inp) return;
    const nameMap = { email: "auth_email", password: "auth_password", full_name: "auth_fullname", workspace_name: "auth_ws" };
    const key = nameMap[inp.name];
    if (key && label.firstChild?.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
      label.firstChild.textContent = t(key) + " ";
    }
  });
  const loginBtn = document.querySelector("#login-form button[type='submit']");
  if (loginBtn) loginBtn.textContent = t("auth_signin") + " →";
  const regBtn = document.querySelector("#register-form button[type='submit']");
  if (regBtn) regBtn.textContent = t("auth_create") + " →";
}

function bindAuth() {
  const langSel = document.getElementById("auth-lang-select");
  if (langSel) {
    langSel.value = state.lang;
    langSel.addEventListener("change", () => {
      state.lang = langSel.value;
      localStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, state.lang);
      applyAuthI18n();
    });
    applyAuthI18n();
  }
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".tab");
  tabs.forEach(tabBtn => tabBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    tabs.forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
    tabBtn.classList.add("active");
    const which = tabBtn.dataset.tab;
    document.getElementById("login-form").classList.toggle("hidden", which !== "login");
    document.getElementById("register-form").classList.toggle("hidden", which !== "register");
  }));

  document.getElementById("login-form").addEventListener("submit", async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const fd = new FormData(e.target);
    try {
      const tok = await api("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: Object.fromEntries(fd) });
      saveToken(tok.access_token);
      state.user = await api("/auth/me");
      try { const wss = await api("/workspaces"); state.workspace = wss?.[0] || null; } catch {}
      await enterApp();
    } catch (err) { document.getElementById("auth-error").textContent = err.message; }
  });

  // "Entrar como demo" — 1-click login with demo credentials
  document.getElementById("auth-demo-btn")?.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const errEl = document.getElementById("auth-error");
    errEl.textContent = "";
    try {
      const tok = await api("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: { email: "demo@visiquost.app", password: "demo1234" } });
      saveToken(tok.access_token);
      state.user = await api("/auth/me");
      try { const wss = await api("/workspaces"); state.workspace = wss?.[0] || null; } catch {}
      await enterApp();
    } catch (err) {
      errEl.textContent = (state.lang === "pt")
        ? `Demo indisponivel: ${err.message}. Rode "python scripts/bootstrap.py" no backend para criar a conta demo.`
        : `Demo unavailable: ${err.message}. Run "python scripts/bootstrap.py" in backend to create the demo account.`;
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("register-form").addEventListener("submit", async e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const fd = new FormData(e.target);
    try {
      const tok = await api("/auth/register", { method: "POST", body: Object.fromEntries(fd) });
      saveToken(tok.access_token);
      state.user = await api("/auth/me");
      try { const wss = await api("/workspaces"); state.workspace = wss?.[0] || null; } catch {}
      await enterApp();
    } catch (err) { document.getElementById("auth-error").textContent = err.message; }
  });

  document.getElementById("logout-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    clearToken();
    state.user = null;
    show("auth");
  });
}

function show(view) {
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-view]").forEach(el => {
    if (el.dataset.view === view || el.id === "app") el.classList.remove("hidden");
    else el.classList.add("hidden");
  });
  // Lock viewport para app (sidebars fixas, main scrolla).
  // Auth/loading scrollam natural para caber em telas pequenas.
  document.body.classList.toggle("app-active", view === "app");
}

// ==================== INBOX ====================
const INBOX_READ_KEY = "visiquost.inbox.readCursor";  // ISO timestamp of latest read
function _getReadCursor() { return localStorage.getItem(INBOX_READ_KEY) || "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"; }
function _setReadCursor(ts) { localStorage.setItem(INBOX_READ_KEY, ts); }

async function refreshInboxBadge() {
  try {
    const page = await api("/activities?limit=50");
    const cursor = new Date(_getReadCursor());
    const unread = (page.items || []).filter(a => new Date(a.occurred_at) > cursor).length;
    const badge = document.getElementById("inbox-badge");
    if (!badge) return;
    if (unread > 0) {
      badge.textContent = unread > 99 ? "99+" : unread;
      badge.classList.remove("hidden");
    } else {
      badge.classList.add("hidden");
    }
  } catch {}
}

async function openInbox() {
  const inbox = document.getElementById("inbox");
  const list = document.getElementById("inbox-list");
  if (!inbox || !list) return;
  inbox.classList.remove("hidden");
  list.innerHTML = `<li class="empty">${t("loading") || "…"}</li>`;
  try {
    const page = await api("/activities?limit=50");
    const cursor = new Date(_getReadCursor());
    const items = page.items || [];
    if (!items.length) {
      const isPT = (state.lang || "pt") === "pt";
      list.innerHTML = `<li class="empty">
        <div class="empty-ico">📥</div>
        <div class="empty-title">${isPT ? "Caixa vazia" : "Inbox empty"}</div>
        <div class="empty-hint">${isPT ? "Atividades novas aparecem aqui — criações, edições, deleções." : "New activity shows here — creates, edits, deletes."}</div>
      </li>`;
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = "";
    const ICON = {
      created: "➕", updated: "✏️", deleted: "🗑️",
      call: "📞", email: "✉️", won: "🏆", lost: "💔",
    };
    for (const a of items) {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const unread = new Date(a.occurred_at) > cursor;
      li.className = unread ? "unread" : "";
      const when = new Date(a.occurred_at);
      li.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;">
          <span style="font-size:1.15em;">${ICON[a.kind] || "•"}</span>
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
            <div><strong>${escapeHtml(a.kind)}</strong> ${escapeHtml(a.subject_type || "")}${a.summary ? " — " + escapeHtml(a.summary) : ""}</div>
            <div class="inbox-when" title="${when.toLocaleString()}">${timeAgo(when)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      list.appendChild(li);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    list.innerHTML = `<li class="error">${t("t_error")}: ${err.message}</li>`;
  }
}

function bindInbox() {
  document.getElementById("open-inbox")?.addEventListener("click", openInbox);
  document.getElementById("inbox-close")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    document.getElementById("inbox")?.classList.add("hidden");
  });
  document.getElementById("inbox-mark-read")?.addEventListener("click", () => {
    _setReadCursor(new Date().toISOString());
    refreshInboxBadge();
    openInbox();  // re-render without unread highlights
  });
  // Poll every 60s
  setInterval(refreshInboxBadge, 60_000);
  refreshInboxBadge();
}

  document.querySelectorAll("#dashboard-window .chip").forEach(chip => {
